value.message: Riverbend Community Centre runs Parent & Tot Playtime for 12 months to 4 years, Tuesdays and Thursdays 9:30-11:00 a.m., Sept 8 to Dec 11 - their site says. Price isn't posted; they say to check the fee schedule at the front desk or by calling. I'll keep watching and text you when they post pricing and registration details.
